sources.title: RPM V4 Package format
sources.use: Four sections; signature-header padding; complete header and compressed payload comparison proposal.

sources.title: RPM Package Header format
sources.use: Bounded raw framing only; native RPM remains semantic/cryptographic authority.

sources.title: RPM Package Lead format
sources.use: 96-byte lead and signature type fields; lead major alone is not a substitute for v4 header-region validation.
